verdict.rationale: uv provides a pip-compatible interface to install from PyPI (the large, actively maintained Python package registry), plus uv add/uv pip install, uvx/uv tool install for standalone tools, and uv python install for Python versions itself, all backed by docs and corroborated by community usage reports of successful installs. missing for 10: no first-party evidence of uv operating its own separate large registry (it relies on PyPI), and no independent audit of registry breadth/uptime beyond docs and anecdotal HN comments.
